power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_starti: ?-țideț, d aɛeqqa n tis snat n tis snat.
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.name: aɣeṭṭas
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.desc: Yiwen ixeddamen ameqqran, yesɛan leḥṛam ɛlayen yerna yexdem lbabuṛ-is.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_repair: Lbabuṛ n lmeṣnuɛat ț-țaǧǧaǧaǧ, tuɣaleḍ aț-țesɛu ṭṭmeɛ.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_forge_: Ifassen n lḥaǧa zemren adɣaɣ am ublac n azṛu.
Tețțawi-d ddnub n tmes, leḥwayeǧ, leɛṭeṛ akk-d tmes ; tmes ur nesɛi azal.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_starti: Ṛebɛa nniḍen s ṛebɛa teswiɛt n tbuciḍant iwakken a d-ibeggnen lmeṣnuɛat-nni.
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.name: Tefki
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.descriptio: Yiwet n tmusni i gxeddmen lqut yesɛan azal, yesɛan XP si ddheb.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.name: Tečča n lɛali
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.descrip: Aččan i kkun-ixeddmen ad ițțunefken lqut d leḥzen.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.name: Tigzirt n Lquds
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.descri: Dɣa mkul yiwen deg-sen yeḥwaǧ aẓekka yelhan.
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.name: Merchant
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.descri: Yiwen ixeddamen ixeddmen lefhama, ur yezmir ara a t-ixeddmen taddart-is, yufa lfayda ixeddamen-nsen.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_trades.d: Ur k-tețțawi ara lecɣal n tudrin.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_rare_loo: ?ef wannect-agi, wid ixeddmen leḥṛam, țțawin-kkun a kkun-yefk ccɣel iɛessasen n taddart akk-d lemɣawla n ugerruj nniḍen.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_silver_t: ?ef wannect-agi i k-d-yefkan ṭṭmeɛ di teswiɛt n lǧehd-ik ɛeddan di teswiɛt n lǧehd-ik iwakken aț-țesɛuḍ tudert n ṭṭmeɛ.
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.name: Agellid
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.descript: Yiwen lɛeqliya n Sidi Ṛebbi yesɛan tazmert s wayes yesɛan tazmert, yesɛan leɛtab n leɛqel.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_enchanting: Lmeṣnuɛat ixeddmen lmeṣnuɛat iwakken ad sɛuɣ ssnen ssḥur ifeṛqen zdat-ek.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_potions.de: Lecɣal n leɛqel i gɛeddan sin wussan.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_divine_sig: Axaṭer tețwali di tafat ur nesɛi lfayda, d ṛṛeḥma i d-ițțunefken seg igenwan.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_starting_b: Ɣef yiwet n tektabt ițțusemman iwakken ad iẓalen d imeslayen n tẓallit.
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.name: Nitwit
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.descript: Mačči d ayen yelhan acemma. Ma yella ur nesɛi ara abrid yesɛan lḥeqq.
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.name: Urara
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.descript: Tudert ɣer uḍebɛin n waman, tețțawi-d leḥṛam seg ufella n lebḥeṛ, tesfeǧǧa am ṭṭwabeɛ, tebda s uɛekkaz ițțubarek.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_waters_luc: +1 m'ara tesɛuḍ di waman, ṣṣifa-k-id ṣṣifa.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_sea_legs.d: Ɣerɣen-d acḥal n lexṣaṛ, ițwaḥebsen i lqayen.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_starting_r: ?-țideț, s uɛekkaz n lebḥeṛ ț-țaɛekkaz n lebḥeṛ, ț-țideț d Lul.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_night_sigh: Iɛeǧben di yiḍ m'ara d-yawi waman.
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.name: Amaṣṣut
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.descripti: Adɣaɣ yefka-d ifassen ifassen ; yebḍa-d snat, ssawḍen-d lǧețța n tgejmaɛt ; daymi i d-yețwaxleq lǧețța n tnefsit.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_hands: Ifassen n lḥaǧa zemren adɣaɣ am ublac n azṛu.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_strong_grip: + 1 tnejmaɛt s wayes ițțusemman di ddunit-agi.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_block_reach: ?ef wannect-agi, ma yewweḍ-ed lmut n Majson
+ 1 iseflawen yewweḍ-ed ; taɣect n leḥṛam teẓra anda iɛeddi di leɛyaḍ.
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.name: Paladin
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.descrip: Iɛeskeṛ imqeddes, ur yemmut ara, ur yezmir ara a t-ṭṭfeɛ, tafat n leḥṛam yesseḥla-d leḥwayeǧ.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_beacon_re: Axaṭer, m'ara d-yefk ṛebɛa lḥaǧa s wayes ara d-yefk ṛebɛa snat n ṭṭmeɛ.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_effect_im: Ɣef wannect-agi i d-yusan lǧiha n lǧiha, ur tezmir ara a kkun-innulen.
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.name: Necromancer
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.descripti: D amɛellem n lmut i d-yefka lameṛ n leḥṛam ur nmețțat ara, d iɛebbaṛ akk-d ifassen n tnefsit-ik, ma d tazmert-ik tețqellibeḍ ɣer wexxam-nsen.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_with: ?ef wannect-agi, ḥesben-d aɛekkaz iwakken aț-țnaɣem ɣef ddemma-inek. Mazal-nni tnaf n lḥaǧa iseḥḥa ; 30-es seniyen ; tețțemḍeggṛeḍ yiwen n lexṣaṛ ma yemmut di ṭṭmeɛ.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_skel: Ɣef wannect-agi, iḥesben iman-ik a t-id-yefk acemma iwakken aț-țnaɣem ɣef ddemma-inek. Ɛeddan-ed ṛebɛa lfayda, 20-es seniyen ; tețțemḍeggṛeḍ yiwen n lexsaṛa ma yemmut di ṭṭmeɛ.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_entity_grou: Sklassifit am ur nemmut ara. Iḍuɛen si leḥmala n Instant, yesseḥla si ddnub instan, i d-ițaǧǧa Sidi Ṛebbi.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_water_breat: Ur ilaq ara ad yesɛu Ṛṛuḥ iqedsen, ur ilaq ara ad ițțunefken i dayem ɣef waman.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_night_visio: Tzemrem aț-țeẓrem di ṭṭlam. Tbeggiḍ-ed aț-țfeǧǧiǧ deg aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (imezwura K).
power.neoorigins.necromancer_daylight_da: M'ara d-yaweḍ tis snat 1,5 cceṛ m'ara d-yawi yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_reduced_hea: -3 ulawen (-6 taxaṭer HP). Lǧețța yesɛan tazmert s lmut.
Tazmert n ṣṣifa n ṣṣifa tzemreḍ aț-țesɛedda d 40 % n tnefsit.
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.name: Gorgon
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.description: Yiwet n wedɣaɣ iwumi yesɛan azṛu i d-ițwaḍeggṛen, iḍeggeṛ-asen, ma d azṛu yesɛan lbabuṛ mkul yiwen deg-sen.
Iɛdawen meṛṛa i gzedɣen zdat-es s leɛqel V. Tlata iǧehden, 15-es seǧǧa issefhem.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.name: Imukan d idɣaɣen
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.desc: A d-yefk ṛebɛa lexṣaṣ i deg ara d-yefk deg-s.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_granite_hide.des: Ur ṭṭmeɛeɣ ara ad qqimen i dayem, aɣeṭṭas n izedɣaɣ yesseɣli-d aṭas n lexbaṛ.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.name: ?ess
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.name: Imeqqranen a d-yefk lḥal
power.neoorigins.gorgon_hunger_drain.des: Tesɛi lǧehd deg-s 50% ifeṛḥen, iwakken aț-țesɛum azṛu yesɛan azṛu.
origins.neoorigins.automaton.name: Automaton
origins.neoorigins.automaton.description: Tazmert ur nesɛi ara lxuluq, meɛna d leḥṛam i gesseḥlu, d ayen yesɛan tazmert, d ayen yesɛan tazmert, d ayen akk i d-yețțaken.
power.neoorigins.automaton_iron_frame.de: Ur ṭṭmeɛeɣ ara ad ḥekkmeɣ deg dayem, ur d-tețțawi ara yiwet n ticmatin iǧehden.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.name: Cassis yețwaḍeggeṛ
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.desc: Ur ilaq ara ad isseǧǧ, ur yezmir ad ɣummen.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_hunger.des: Ur țțuɣal ara aț-țelluẓem, aț-țerfeḍ ɣef wexxam n daxel.
power.neoorigins.automaton_hide_hunger_b: Amur-nni yeffren ffren, ur tețțen ara idrimen.
Amur-nni yeffren, ur țțaǧan ara lǧețțat ara.
power.neoorigins.automaton_potion_resist: Immura n leǧwahi i d-yețțaken lǧil, lǧehd imeqqranen akk-d leḥṛam ; mazal lfayda nniḍen yesɛan azal.
Iɛsekṛiyen nnejmaɛen nnejmaɛen i d-yefkan lbeṛhan di ṭṭlam. Tbeggneḍ-ed aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (imezwura K).
Leḥlub yesɛan ṣṣifa yețțawi-d s leḥsab n leɛtab n 25%, yebnan iwakken ad ṣṣbeṛ neɣ ad isseḥlu.
power.neoorigins.automaton_knockback_res: 40% n tnefsit n ddnub n ddnub n ddnub.
origins.neoorigins.kraken.name: Kraken
origins.neoorigins.kraken.description: Yiwet n lebḥeṛ ameqqran i d-ilulen di lebḥeṛ yeldi, yesseɣli-d lebḥeṛ s ṭṭmeɛ n lebḥeṛ, ssawḍen-d iɛessasen ; ma d lebḥeṛ i d-ițwaɛeḍḍsen, yeɣli-d yiṭij, yesseɣli-d ɣef wuḍar.
power.neoorigins.kraken_tentacle_lash.de: Tmes yiwen uɣebbaḍ n ṭṭlam i gesderɣel i iɛdawen meṛṛa di teswiɛt n iseflawen ; tnefsit-ed snat n tnefsit.
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.name: ?eqqṛit n lḥal
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.descrip: Tmes taɣect n ṭṭmeɛ iɛdawen di ṭṭmeɛt n lqaɛa nniḍen ; ṛebɛa lfayda nniḍen, 8-es seǧǧa n tmes.
S waman yesɛan lǧil ɣer lǧil, ițwali s waman ur nesɛi taɣect.
